description: Free, no API key. Returns the median days to pay for one UK sector (SIC division), across companies, with the average share of payments beyond 60 days across companies, the report count, the period covered and the as-of date. Coverage is large companies that must report under the UK payment practices rules. It is not all companies. Returns value null with a reason when a sector has fewer than 30 companies or no match. Each answer states its date and its source. Returns JSON with fields value, unit, pct_beyond_60, sic_division, sector_label, n_reports, n_companies, period_covered, as_of, source, coverage_note, caveat, url, or value and reason. Indicator to verify, not advice.

sector.description: Optional. A word from the sector name. For example wholesale. Use sic_division when a word matches several sectors.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 10 for food manufacturing.

name: sector_payment_days
title: UK sector days to pay
